detail: gpu_gpc=0 or 1 sets bit 1 of 0x7a4d882 ("Will[ NOT] use GPC/Fender because you specified gpu_gpc=N")

bit 2 = 4 only if a Fender register range exists (0x7a4d87d != 0xff) AND (bit 1 OR bit 3) AND bit 0 (bit 0 is set earlier; its source was not decoded). With gpu_gpc=0 and bit 3 clear, bit 2 is 0: no first wake, no 1 -> 0 request, no GFX power cycle at accelerator start
flags == 0 or bit 0 set: if bit 1 of 0x7a4d882 is clear, store straight to RGX (accel +0xd10 + reg); if set, append to ConfigRAM with flag 0xff. Flags non-zero with bit 0 clear: do nothing
only if a Fender object exists: +0x10 = 0, +0 = 0x40000000, cursor = 0x10000
SOFT_RESET (0x100) = 0x00e7fffffffffc1d (64-bit, flags 1). Nothing writes RGX before it on either path
SOFT_RESET = 0x00e7fe071ffffc1d, then 0x0000000100000000, then the rest of the 30-word program (fender-configram.tsv in the request 4 result)
with Fender: SOFT_RESET = 0 as a ConfigRAM entry, then the end marker
SOFT_RESET = 0 written straight to RGX (fw +0x1e8, flags 1), then waitForFWAlive
+0x20000 = 0, then +0x1000 = 0x11, then waitForFWAlive. The override release and the 0 -> 1 request take the place of the direct "SOFT_RESET = 0" release
nothing besides the provider gate calls (+0x568/+0x570, GFX id 124). No META/BIF clock write, no PMGR write, no "gpu_gpc"-specific RGX write before SOFT_RESET exists in the kext
